name: Ancient Lugian Fortress
title: Ancient Lugian Fortress
summary: Mare Tukal, a Linvak Tukal-style Lugian city of 47 stone towers and halls (16-116 m tall) packed into one landblock (x 3456-3636, y 576-756) at the bottom of a sunken sea basin off the south-west corner of Dereth (99.1S 87.1W): the basin floor is shallow still water at z 2, its walls are running water climbing to a sea rim at z 50 lined with lights, and the deep sea falls away beyond. The tallest tower rises 116 m at (3516, 684); a Lugian Life Stone sits on the central tower's terrace at z 51.

landmarks.name: Sea rim
landmarks.note: Running-water walls from z 2 to 50 around the basin.

shots.standingOrder: Start looking down at the sea on the rim south-west of the sunken city and tilt up to reveal the Lugian towers rising from the water, sun behind; keep 25 m above the rim.
shots.notes: Signature water reveal: starts 85 m up over the sea rim south-west of the sunken basin, looking 55 deg down at the water, and tilts up to -8 deg: the waterfall walls of the basin and then the Lugian towers (up to 116 m) rising from the still water fill the frame from t 4-7 (proj.mjs), sun behind. Subject point = the south-west corner tower (lead-in hides it by design until t 4). Verified (check.mjs, full take flown): take 0-10 s: AGL 52.53..53.6 m, nearest drawn 162.93 m (static 0x1203#218 0x01001F03), vmax 0.94 m/s, LOS blocked 0/41, subject in frame 63%, over water 100%; edit 3.5-9.5 s: AGL 52.53..53.3 m, nearest drawn 162.96 m (static 0x1203#218 0x01001F03), vmax 0.94 m/s, LOS blocked 0/25, subject in frame 96%, over water 100%; flight cinema peak 0.94 m/s (cap 12), max tracking gap 0.01 m.

shots.standingOrder: Orbit a slow arc 130 m out and 175 m above the sunken sea basin around the Lugian city with the sun behind; keep 30 m above the rim.
shots.notes: High orbit 130 m out and 175 m above the basin (wide 72 deg lens), looking 42 deg down into the sunken city: the tower tops, the shallow inner water, the running-water walls and the sea rim with its lights, 100 % over water; sun behind. Subject point = the 116 m tallest tower. shots.standingOrder: Lock off south of the sunken Lugian city above the sea rim and let the clouds race over the towers; no movement.
shots.notes: Locked-off time-lapse from 180 m south, 51 m above the sea rim: clouds race over the Lugian towers while the light shifts (rate 0.012 game-days/s: about 2.3 h of sky in the take, the sun stays up); sun behind-right.
